subject: Mutual plan — draft milestones, legal owners & SLA questions (Finexa)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Benton <claire@finexa.com>, Samir Patel <s.patel@finexa.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual plan — draft milestones, legal owners & SLA questions (Finexa)

Thanks again for the time today — solid conversation and clear alignment on business value. Per our call, I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) that captures milestones, owners and target dates. Please review and confirm or flag edits. Quick summary of the key MAP milestones relevant to legal/procurement: 

- Milestone: Execute MSA + DPA
  - Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole (Legal) — initial pass + tracked changes
  - Owner (Finexa): Samir Patel (Legal) — review & counter
  - Target: initial redlines exchanged by 2027-02-16, final execution target 2027-02-28
  - Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence, subprocessor list, KMS/residency answers
  - Proposed Redwood turnaround: 2 business days for initial review after receipt of counter-redlines

- Milestone: SLA metric sign-off
  - Owner (Redwood): Marcus Lin (PS/Platform) — provide SLA details and measurements
  - Owner (Finexa): Claire / procurement to confirm acceptable SLOs and PO terms
  - Dependency: definition of RTO/RPO for incident handling and breach credits

Action items I need from your side to keep the timeline: 
1) Samir — can you confirm whether Finexa will aim to provide redlines by Tue 2/16?
2) Claire/procurement — do you need any contract templates or PO terms from us before we exchange redlines?
3) Marcus — I asked you to attach the SLA summary (SLA_summary_v1.pdf) and a short note on measurement.

Attachments: [Attachment: Finexa_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)]

If everyone is good with the owners and dates above, I’ll update the MAP and push a version with explicit row-level owners and acceptance criteria.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com]
From: Claire Benton <claire@finexa.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <s.patel@finexa.com>
Cc: procure@finexa.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:37:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mutual plan — draft milestones, legal owners & SLA questions (Finexa)

Thanks Hannah — the MAP looks good at high level. A couple quick notes from procurement side: 

- We typically route commercial terms early; procurement is looping in PO team (procure@finexa.com) to confirm PO timing.
- For the SLA: finance/procurement will need the credit table and clear measurement window before agreeing PO language.

Samir — can you take a look at the MAP legal section and advise whether Finexa can provide redlines by Tue 2/16? If not, tell us your expected date. We’d like to keep the 2/28 execution target but can slide by a few days if needed.

Happy to set a short call to go through the SLA metrics if that helps.

— Claire
Claire Benton
Head of Data Partnerships, Finexa Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <s.patel@finexa.com>, Claire Benton <claire@finexa.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual plan — draft milestones, legal owners & SLA questions (Finexa)

Hi all — looping in from Redwood Legal. Thanks for the clear MAP, Hannah. A few process notes and commitments from our side so expectations are aligned: 

- Redwood legal ownership: I will be the primary reviewer for the MSA/DPA and will produce an initial redline (tracked) within 2 business days after we receive Finexa’s counter-redlines. If you start from our MSA, we can aim to exchange comments on the timeline below.
- Proposed Redwood internal turnaround: 48 hours for initial pass; 3 business days for broader review if new commercial/legal issues surface.
- Standard items that typically need focused discussion: data residency/subprocessors, indemnity cap language, SLA credits and uptime definitions, and breach notification timelines. If Finexa wants alternative language on KMS/key access, flag that early and we’ll prioritize.

I attached a baseline redline of our standard MSA with annotations on the areas we expect back-and-forth: [Attachment: MSA_redlines_v1.docx (docx, 68KB)]. Please note the document is our starting point — if you’re sending counter-redlines, request they are in tracked changes to speed review.

Requested items from Finexa before we can finalize the MAP dependency list: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (or pending date)
- Current subprocessor list + any TOA requests
- Confirmation on whether data residency must remain in-region (US only) for production data

Suggested next step: schedule a 30-minute call between Samir, Marissa and Marcus to walk the SLA measurement and incident handling language — propose Thu 2/18 10:00 AM ET. If that works for Finexa, I’ll send a calendar invite.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <s.patel@finexa.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Claire Benton <claire@finexa.com>
Cc: procure@finexa.com
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual plan — draft milestones, legal owners & SLA questions (Finexa)

Appreciate the clear runbook. We can aim to get initial counter-redlines to you by Tue 2/16 EOD PST — I’ll confirm if anything slips. A few immediate asks from Finexa Legal to include in the MAP dependencies: 

1) Please provide SOC 2 Type II report and the list of subprocessors (if you can share the latter as a spreadsheet that’s ideal).
2) Data residency: Finexa requires production customer data to remain in the US; please confirm how Redwood currently supports region scoping and whether there are restrictions for backup/replication.
3) SLA detail: we want to review the credit table and the measurement windows. A short call to walk through those definitions would be helpful — Thu 2/18 10:00 AM ET works for me; please send invite.

I will prepare an initial set of redlines focused on indemnity, data residency, subprocessor obligations, and SLA credits. If Redwood’s legal can guarantee a 48-hour turnaround on our counters, that will help keep the 2/28 execution target realistic.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Senior Counsel, Finexa Analytics
[s.patel@finexa.com]

Thanks Samir — appreciated. I’ve penciled in Thu 2/18 10:00 AM ET for the SLA call and will send invite to all. Quick internal follow-up so owners are explicit: 

- Marissa: lead legal redline coordination and produce responses within 48 hours of receiving counters (as discussed).
- Marcus: present SLA measurement & incident runbook on Thu call; provide SLA_summary_v1.pdf to Claire/procurement by EOD 2/17.
- Hannah: update MAP rows with confirmed dates and dependencies after the call; will push MAP v1.1 to the shared Drive and attach final artifacts to the CRM record (DEAL-7821).

I’ll attach the SOC2 pointer and subprocessor export once I have them from Security — expect those by EOD 2/17.

— Hannah
